title: How Bally Bagayoko, a 53-Year-Old Mayor, Became the Face of France’s Youth Protests
summary: Bally Bagayoko, the mayor of a working-class suburb near Paris, has been a regular presence at student demonstrations, prompting both applause and condemnation.
